deadline.value: The priority deadline for fellowship and scholarship consideration is December 1; applications are reviewed on a rolling basis after it.
deadline.quote: Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis after the December 1st priority deadline

gre_subject.value: GRE scores are no longer required, but the department says to include them if you have them.
gre_subject.quote: GRE Scores are no longer required for admission, but feel free to include them to strengthen your application if you have them

gre_general.value: GRE scores are no longer required, but the department says to include them if you have them.
gre_general.quote: GRE Scores are no longer required for admission, but feel free to include them to strengthen your application if you have them

toefl_min.value: Department TOEFL minimum is 79 (internet-based), the same as the Graduate School.

ielts_min.value: Department IELTS minimum is 6.5, the same as the Graduate School.

supervisor.value: A committee reviews applications, so you do not need to contact individual faculty first.
supervisor.quote: A committee reviews applications; you do not need to contact individual faculty members

funding.value: Support is guaranteed for 5.5 years to incoming students who are qualified to teach undergraduate labs, which is not every admitted applicant.
funding.quote: Our Department guarantees 5.5 years of support to all incoming students who are qualified to teach in our undergraduate laboratory courses

entry_route.value: The department welcomes applicants straight from a four-year undergraduate programme as well as non-traditional applicants.
entry_route.quote: We are also open to applicants who are not applying directly out of a four-year undergraduate program

notes: About 20 students admitted each Fall; spring admission is almost never offered. The department's own TOEFL and IELTS minimums match the Graduate School's. The page's Dates & Deadlines block is split across lines, so the December 1 date is taken from the sentence. Master's coursework only is accepted for MS.
